profile.goodFor: tone shaping with up to 16 bands: cutting mud, rumble and harshness, adding air; each band's settings end in its number (0 to 15)

settings.name: Filter type 0
settings.what: band 0's kind: Off, Bell, Hi-pass, shelves, Lo-pass, Notch...; every band starts Off

settings.name: Frequency 0
settings.what: band 0's frequency (each band has its own)

settings.name: Gain 0
settings.what: band 0's boost or cut (not for pass and notch filters)

settings.name: Filter slope 0
settings.what: how steep band 0's pass or shelf filter is

settings.name: Equalizer mode
settings.what: IIR (no added delay) is the usual; the others add latency
